topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Hey, I can't even begin to tell you what I just found out! My partner, you know, the one who’s always been a bit of a bookworm? Well, turns out they’ve been weaving a whole novel around me. Can you believe it? Whole chapters filled with our moments, the stuff we laugh about, the crazy adventures we’ve had. It’s like they took our life and sprinkled it with magic or something. I haven’t even finished reading it, but it’s already doing something funny to my heart. I don’t know whether to burst into tears or jump for joy. But whatever it is, it’s definitely something I never expected to find in a stack of old notebooks tucked away in a drawer.
